editedExercise.name: Incline Push-Up

instructions.description: Place your hands on a stable bench or other elevated surface, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart. Keep your fingers pointing forward or slightly outward.
Step your feet back until your body forms a straight line from head to heels. Engage your core and glutes, keep your neck neutral, and maintain a stable torso.
Bend your elbows and slowly lower your chest toward the surface. Keep your elbows at a comfortable angle rather than letting them flare widely, while maintaining your body alignment.
Press firmly through your hands to return to the starting position. Keep your core engaged and your body moving as one unit.

variations.variationDescription: Wall Push-Up provides a meaningfully different loading, support, or stability option compared with Incline Push-Up.
Standard Push-Up meaningfully changes the difficulty, loading, support, or movement demands compared with Incline Push-Up.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Use a deliberately slower lowering phase without creating a separate database record.
Use a smaller comfortable range while preserving the same movement pattern.

commentsNotes: Use a stable surface that cannot slide or tip.
Keep your body in a straight line and avoid letting your hips sag or rise.
Keep your core gently engaged throughout the movement.
Keep your shoulders away from your ears.
Use a higher surface for an easier variation and a lower surface for more challenge.
